resolvedTitle: Template:Data Aphelios/The Hitman and the Seer

fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aphelios''' has access to an arsenal of 5 ''Moonstone Weapons'', created by his sister '''Alune'''. He equips two weapons at any one time, one as his {{as|main weapon}} and one as his {{as|off-hand}}. Each weapon has a unique {{tip|basic attack}} and effect.
fields.description2: '''Aphelios''' begins the game with {{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}} as his {{as|main weapon}} and {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} in his {{as|off-hand}}, with {{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}, {{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}, and {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} queued in reserve. His weapons are initially in this order, but they can be rearranged based on their usage.
fields.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Moonlight:}} Weapons granted to '''Aphelios''' have 50 ''Moonlight'' for [[ammunition]], which is consumed upon basic attacking {{tip|on-attack}} and upon casting his {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary abilities}}. Any of his abilities that automatically cause him to attack during their effect will not consume additional ''Moonlight''. Once his {{as|main weapon's}} ''Moonlight'' is exhausted, it is moved to the end of the reserve queue; '''Alune''' then assembles his next available weapon from the reserve over 1 second, placing its {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary ability}} on a {{fd|1.5}}-second {{sti|cooldown}} from the start of the assembly. '''Aphelios''' cannot cast ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' during the assembly.
fields.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Weapon Master:}} '''Aphelios''' cannot improve his abilities via [[Experience (champion)|skill points]]. He starts the game with ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' and automatically gains access to his [[File:Q.png|20px|link=]] primary abilities at level 2 and his [[File:R.png|20px|link=]] ultimate ability, ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'', at level 6. ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'' improves automatically at levels 11 and 16. '''Aphelios''' may spend his skill points to gain {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} or {{sti|{{as|lethality}}}} instead.
fields.notes:
* The [[attack damage]], [[attack speed]] and [[lethality]] within '''Aphelios' '''unique rank-up menu in the HUD correspond to the Q, W, E ability rank-up [[hotkey]]s, respectively, for the purposes of assigning skill points via keyboard.
* Due to '''Aphelios''' lacking a fourth rankup option (R), his point assigment does not follow the same rules as other champions.
** For example, the earliest level that an individual statistic can attain rank 6 is level 9, by assigning points at levels {{ap|1|2|3|5|7|9}}.
* An ammunition counter will appear to the right side of the screen when '''Aphelios' '''{{as|main weapon}} has 10 or less ''Moonlight''.
* While at lower than 10 ''Moonlight'', casting his {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary abilities}} will not spend additional ''Moonlight'' but instead consume all the remaining points.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} will not consume additional ''Moonlight'' when firing its bolts.
* The in-game tooltip will reflect the current order of weapons.
